svg.title: Lesson 0006 overview: ROS 2 perception wiring
svg.desc: A 12-station hand-drawn technical overview sheet. Stations read from 1 to 12, left to right and top to bottom.
svg.text: named topics; the detector is one
Two image messages are paired with
queue 10 and a configured 0.05 s slop.
RGB becomes bgr8 for OpenCV; depth
uses passthrough so its numeric format
Non-uint16 or non-2D depth is skipped
sensor_msgs/Image with an M5 HUD when
ros2 topic info, echo, and hz reveal
